# GrowthPilot

> AI growth diagnostics for social media creators — find out exactly why your profile isn't growing and what to fix.

GrowthPilot analyzes a creator's public Instagram signals (bio, posting cadence, engagement patterns, niche fit, format mix), benchmarks them against top performers, and returns a Growth Score with a prioritized fix list and premium report.
